review_scope: all ten original-resolution individual-renderer black and neutral-gray proofs
accepted_technical_findings: Isolation, centering, clipping, dual-background capture, render-texture cleanup, Console state and protected hashes pass and may be reused.
The five outer silhouettes are now different from one another.
These technical and silhouette distinctions do not establish commercial visual approval.
root_findings: Every role still renders as a single uniformly colored flat alpha silhouette with almost no internal hot core, depth, turbulence, breakup or material layering.
The forked core is a thin orange spear-like sticker; its long flat body and sharp tip do not read as living flame volume.
The asymmetric shoulder is a broad solid red-orange diamond or leaf with no shoulder fold, compression, hot center or soft outer body.
The overturn fold is a smooth constant-width dark-red arc that reads as a bent stroke rather than a curling flame volume.
The sagging tail is an extremely dark flat torn wedge that becomes nearly invisible on neutral gray and still resembles a mask cutout.
The terminal ember is another solid coral flat wisp with no volumetric ember core, rim breakup or depth transition.
R8 changes the outline but repeats the rejected picture-plus-mask workflow and remains far below the supplied school-example flame and commercial VFX quality floor.

r9_binding_requirements.prototype_limit: Build only two representative roles first: HotCoreForkedLick and DarkRedOpenOverturnFold. Do not propagate to all five until these two pass Root review.
r9_binding_requirements.geometry: Each prototype must use real shallow closed or crossed 3D flame geometry with a readable curved cross-section and perspective depth. A single quad, flat billboard, alpha-only silhouette or uniformly extruded card is forbidden.
r9_binding_requirements.layering: Each prototype must contain at least three visually separate depth/value layers: compact white-yellow hot inner core, orange/red mid body and softer darker outer falloff or smoke-edge layer. The layers may be submeshes or nested volumes but must remain readable when isolated.
r9_binding_requirements.hot_core: Create a compact forked flame tongue with one dominant curved lobe, one shorter unequal split, thicker captured root and tapered forward tip. It must show depth and uneven internal flow from a three-quarter proof view.
r9_binding_requirements.overturn_fold: Create an open curling overturn volume with a thick root, expanding outer shoulder, narrowing hooked return and visible inner hollow or fold. It may not read as a constant-width arc, ring segment or tube.
r9_binding_requirements.surface: Use authored gradient/noise breakup or multiple layered materials to remove the solid sticker fill, while keeping edges clean and avoiding random grain, banding or dirty alpha fringes.
r9_binding_requirements.visibility: Both roles must remain clearly visible and retain internal layer separation on black and neutral gray without excessive bloom.
r9_binding_requirements.proof: Return exactly four original-resolution isolated proofs: the two prototype roles on black and neutral gray at a fixed three-quarter camera. No body, other renderer, label, gizmo, overlay, composite, timeline, final prefab or 30-cycle work.
r9_binding_requirements.immutability: Keep normalized FBX, authored body, R1-R8, source material/masks/GUIDs and original weapon assets read-only. Use a new item-local R9 path only.
